articles.title: Audience capture
articles.summary: Audience capture is the part that scares me the most about writing on the internet. I have the soul of an engineer1: when I see a metric like engagement, I want to improve it. I like to make the number go up. In fact, the whole environment of online writing is tailor-made to help you make engagement numbers go up.
